    Lemma 4.12: exhaustion by sources and sinks #

    lem:cover-exhaustion: "There is an increasing sequence of finite convex full subcategories of L with union L, each obtained from the previous one by adding a source or a sink. […] Consequently L has a multiplicative basis."

    This file proves the abstract form for a thin directed category with a height function, finitely many outgoing lines at each object and countably many objects. Sinks are sources of the opposite category (extend_sink).
